concerns.text: Task T012 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it reads and validates `results/metrics.json` and `results/training_log.json` which are also written by earlier tasks (e.g., T007, T008, T009). Running T012 in parallel with any of those producers could cause race conditions or read partially‑written files, violating the parallel‑safe guarantee.

Task T013 (`run_all.sh`) orchestrates the entire pipeline in strict order. Marking it `[P]` suggests it can be executed concurrently with other tasks, which is contradictory because it depends on *all* prior tasks completing. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.
